en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand neo‑baroque theater building at night with a bright full moon in the sky. People are gathered in the square in front of the building. The left margin has vertical printer information, and below the image is a caption identifying the building as the Croatian National Theater. The right half of the card is filled with handwritten message text, with a red printed heading at the top indicating Zagreb/Agram and a year notation.
